scope: Owner-confirmed register of the current fluid battle animations for all 232 creatures (160 base, 72 approved upgrades). Each unit was visually reviewed when its clips were published; that review and its accepted clips are in the unit_review provenance file, bound to the same atlas hash. A republished animation drops its evidence link until it is registered again.

supersedes.note: Roster-wide in-battle capture review of the earlier articulated clips; every one of those 160 atlases was replaced by later fluid clips (through 2026-10-03). Kept in git history.
